_comment: Single source of truth for numeric limits. VERIFY every value against the official BIS IS 10500:2012 document before presenting. Automated findings support human judgment; they are not official regulatory decisions.

turbidity_ntu.label: Turbidity
turbidity_ntu.note: Acceptable 1 NTU; 5 NTU permissible only when no alternative source exists.

residual_chlorine_mgl.label: Free Residual Chlorine
residual_chlorine_mgl.note: Process control parameter, not a health-based standard. 0.2 mg/L minimum at point of consumption - VERIFY.

total_coliform.label: Total Coliform
total_coliform.note: Must be absent in 100 mL. Presence is an automatic worst-parameter override.

wqi.method: weighted arithmetic sub-index, expressed as a RISK score
wqi.formula: Qi = 100 * |Vi - ideal| / |limit - ideal| for max/min parameters; WQI = sum(wi * Qi) / sum(wi)

worst_parameter_override.rule: If ANY parameter is beyond its permissible limit, or E. coli / total coliform is present, the node cannot score better than Poor (band index >= 2).
worst_parameter_override.required_ui: Show the exact parameter that drove the rating.

wqi.caveat: Passing one parameter does not mean the water is safe.
